title: Opening Visit of the Next Booked Appointment Series on an Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Training note — Insured Plan of Care.** The opening visit of the plan's next booked Appointment Series is taken from its bookings:

- where that series' first booked appointment has been **rescheduled**, it opens on the date the appointment was moved to;
- where it has not been rescheduled and its first booking begins **after** the series' start date, it opens on that first booked appointment;
- otherwise it opens on the series' start date.

The bookings, reschedules and start date are read from the Appointment Series record of the booked series and its history.

## Questions and answers (hypothetical; series start date 2026-08-03)

**First booked appointment 2026-08-03, not rescheduled. Opening visit?** 2026-08-03, the series' start date.

**First booked appointment 2026-08-05, not rescheduled. Opening visit?** 2026-08-05, the booking beginning after the start date.

**First booked appointment 2026-08-05, rescheduled to 2026-08-07. Opening visit?** 2026-08-07, the date it was moved to.
